newsitem.title: THAILAND: Somprasong down limit on bad debt talk.
newsitem.headline: Somprasong down limit on bad debt talk.

text.p: Thailand's Somprasong Land, hit by continuous market talk it faces bad debts despite its denials, fell its limit on Friday, down 1.25 baht to 11.25.
Stock analysts said investors were shunning the property developer's shares after the damaging rumours and also because its prospects for profit growth were poor.

"Our company has recommended to stock investors to stay away from several property developers, including Somprasong Land, because of their small profit growth," said analyst Witawus Charuchandr of Ekachart Finance and Securities.
Property Developers are facing problems in selling homes in Bangkok now due to a huge glut.
For example, there are about 43,000 residential condominium units in Bangkok now, of which only 69 percent are occupied.
